sql:
SELECT L.name 
FROM League L 
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id 
WHERE M.season = '2009/2010' 
GROUP BY L.name 
HAVING AVG(M.home_team_goal) > AVG(M.away_team_goal)
